legacy_value_key_note: net_revenue aliases retain numbers, not financial-statement recognition claims

lenses.title: Transaction-value reconciliation
lenses.question: Do positive and negative values reconcile to the reported net for the same period and scope?
lenses.control: Check the sign, period, unit, eligibility policy and additive identity before interpreting change.
lenses.limit: Net transaction value is not audited financial-statement revenue, profit or cash collected.

lenses.title: Negative-value review
lenses.question: How much negative value comes from merchandise versus fees, adjustments and unknown codes?
lenses.control: Keep sign, invoice cancellation flag and merchandise classification separate. Do not allocate unlinked adjustments to products.
lenses.limit: Negative merchandise lines are not an original-sale-linked physical return rate; cause and timing remain unknown.

lenses.title: Product concentration and ranking
lenses.question: Are product, period, metric, rank and value supported by the same evidence scope?
lenses.control: Check complete relationships and the concentration denominator. Preserve stock-code-plus-description grain for the historical study.
lenses.limit: Sales-value concentration does not establish inventory requirements, demand forecasts, procurement savings or optimal replenishment.

lenses.title: Country exposure and comparison
lenses.question: Are the named countries, comparison direction and amount difference consistent?
lenses.control: Subtract within the same month and scope; distinguish domestic/non-domestic exposure and disclose missing dimensions.
lenses.limit: Transaction geography alone cannot explain market attractiveness, profitability, customer acquisition or causal growth drivers.

source_limits: UCI documents C-prefixed invoices as cancellations. Negative quantity alone does not establish a physical return, cause, original-sale linkage, cash collection, profit, or recognized accounting revenue.
eligible_line_policy: Preserve existing valid-net flags: exclude normalized duplicate copies, missing/blank descriptions and nonpositive unit prices. Missing customer IDs are retained for aggregate analysis, not imputed. No anomaly is automatically removed.
period: December 2010 through December 9, 2011; December 2011 is partial
